# Wrapper Register Map

This page is generated from the shared MMIO address contract and checked by the Python-model CI lane.

## Summary

- Register regions: 7
- Protocol views: 5
- Address constants are checked against `rtl/simple_cpu_mmio.sv` and `tb/mmio_bus.py`.
- APB, Wishbone, and AXI-Lite Python BFMs are checked to reuse the shared MMIO constants.

## Register Regions

| Name | Address | Access | Producer | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SHADOW_IMEM` | `0x00-0x0F` | `RW` | `shadow_imem` | Program shadow image bytes. |
| `STATUS` | `0x10` | `R` | `dbg flags` | Bits `[4:0]` are `HALTED`, `OVERFLOW`, `NEG`, `CARRY`, `ZERO`. |
| `ACC` | `0x11` | `R` | `dbg_acc` | Accumulator debug readback. |
| `PC` | `0x12` | `R` | `dbg_pc` | Program counter debug readback in bits `[3:0]`. |
| `DMEM` | `0x20-0x2F` | `R` | `dbg_mem_data` | Data-memory debug readback selected by address bits `[3:0]`. |
| `CONTROL` | `0x30` | `RW` | `state` | Write bit 0 starts/re-holds execution; read bits `[1:0]` are `LOAD`, `RUN`. |
| `UNMAPPED` | `other` | `R` | `zero` | Unmapped reads return zero; unmapped writes are ignored. |
